# MA Tailor

> MA Tailor is an online Pakistani ladies' dress stitching studio offering custom tailoring with international delivery to USA, UK, Canada, UAE and more.

MA Tailor specializes in custom-stitched Pakistani and Indian women's outfits including shalwar kameez, kurtis, maxis, party wear, and bridal wear. Standard turnaround is 7–10 days stitching plus 15–17 days worldwide delivery. Bulk orders and free samples are available.
